newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brantano to start Brussels trade.
newsitem.headline: Brantano to start Brussels trade.

text.p: Shares in Belgian shoe distributor Brantano NV will start trading on the Brussels bourse on Monday under the Reuter Instrument Code BRAN.BR.
Shares in the initial public offer of a maximum 45 percent, or 1.25 million shares, of the company's capital were issued at 1,120 Belgian francs each.

Brantano, which has a workforce of 558 full-time equivalents, 102 selling points in Belgium and three 'test shops' in France, aims to use the 1.4 billion francs raised through the issue for expansion in Europe.

Brantano sold 3.3 million pairs of shoes in 1996, had net current profit of 173 million francs ($4.9 million) and 324 million ($9.2 million) net cash flow. Turnover rose to 3.37 billion ($95.8 million) from 2.67 billion in 1995.
